title: Add a greeting
request: Create greeting.txt with exactly Hello followed by a newline. Preserve all unrelated files.

proposal.title: Add a greeting
proposal.summary: Deliver a small observable feature with an external check.

acceptance.description: greeting.txt contains exactly Hello and a newline

files.verify.py:
import pathlib, sys
p = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]) / 'greeting.txt'
sys.exit(0 if p.is_file() and p.read_bytes() == b'Hello\n' else 1)
